profile.name: Faktus
profile.description: A self-serve B2B SaaS that turns scattered marketing signals into prioritised decisions for small teams.

objectives.title: Sign five paying pilots this quarter
Cut time-to-first-insight for a new team below one day
Run one experiment per team each week

constraints.title: Bootstrapped, no field hiring this year
A six-week pilot window before the investment decision

learnings.text: Field crews tolerate sync conflicts when the app never blocks: 18 of 40 target sessions completed offline.
A pricing-page rewrite lifted trial starts 12% but did not change paid conversion.
Partner webinars filled pipeline but the leads skewed below the ideal customer profile.

initiatives.prompt: Should we build an offline mode for our field crews app?
initiatives.title: Offline-first companion for field crews
initiatives.pitch: A mobile companion that keeps working when signal drops, so field teams never lose an entry.

initiatives.prompt: Our trial conversion is flat, should we rewrite the pricing page?
initiatives.title: Pricing page rewrite
initiatives.pitch: Rebuild the pricing page around the three plans customers actually reach, with clearer value per tier.

initiatives.prompt: Is a founder-led LinkedIn cadence worth it for us?
initiatives.title: Weekly founder thought-leadership cadence
initiatives.pitch: A founder publishing a practical post a week to build an audience and warm inbound.

initiatives.prompt: Should we run co-marketing webinars with integration partners?
initiatives.title: Partner co-marketing webinar series
initiatives.pitch: Monthly webinars with tool partners to trade audiences and fill the top of the funnel.

initiatives.prompt: Would a free ROI calculator generate qualified leads?
initiatives.title: Free ROI calculator lead magnet
initiatives.pitch: An interactive calculator that lets a prospect estimate the value of consolidating their marketing signals.

initiatives.prompt: Should we add an onboarding email sequence to lift activation?
initiatives.title: Activation email sequence
initiatives.pitch: A short timed sequence that walks a new team to their first insight within a day.

initiatives.prompt: Do we need a rebrand to sell to bigger companies?
initiatives.title: Enterprise-facing rebrand
initiatives.pitch: Refresh positioning and visuals so the product reads credible to a head of marketing at a 500-person company.

initiatives.prompt: Is a user community worth starting now?
initiatives.title: Customer community program
initiatives.pitch: A moderated space where marketing teams share playbooks and pull each other forward.

initiatives.prompt: Should we run a small account-based marketing push?
initiatives.title: ABM pilot to twenty named accounts
initiatives.pitch: A targeted push at twenty ideal accounts with tailored content and direct outreach.

initiatives.prompt: Will a case-study library help close pilots?
initiatives.title: Customer case-study library
initiatives.pitch: Published write-ups of how real teams turned signals into decisions, used as sales proof.
